statements.statement: CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring) was ordered
The patient had recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There was concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1)
There was concern for underlying atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
Continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period is required to capture arrhythmic events
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to service delivery
